notes.title: Dino Run Multiplayer Update / Open-Sourcing The Game
notes.content:
[b]We're open-sourcing Dino Run DX.[/b]

As some of our most dedicated players have discovered, Dino Run DX multiplayer no longer works. The wonderful folks at Xgen Studios, who basically let multiplayer live rent-free for years, had to recently sunset all of their legacy games (like Stick Arena) and the servers that run them. And as you can imagine, Dino Run used those servers.  

They DID send us the source code to the server itself, so maybe we can get it up and running again on our end. However, we haven't been able to compile the actual game for years now, since it's legacy flash and that no longer works on any computer that we own.

So...

1) We've uploaded the Dino Run DX source code to the [i]legacy-dinorun[/i] channel on our discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/JM2MMUf]https://discord.com/invite/JM2MMUf[/url]. It's a pinned post. Anyone that wants to try and compile the game (Using Flash Builder 4.7) is welcome to.  Let us know if you can get it working!

UPDATE: The source also exists on GIT now: https://github.com/pixeljam/DinoRunDX

2) If someone can recompile DX, we'll see if we can get the server up and running on our end with the source that Xgen sent us.

3) We're very close to having a very small multiplayer experience playable for Dino Run 2!  More on that in the coming months.

Thanks for the many lovely memories racing dinos.   Time to pour one out...

notes.title: >> Freerun Screenshot and Video Contest
notes.content:
Ahoy Runners!

To celebrate the kickoff of [b]Freerun Mode[/b] we're having a screenshot and video contest.  Send us your best moments and we'll make it worth your while!

[b]Here's how it works:[/b]
- Take screenshots and video footage from Freerun Mode.  It can be single player or multiplayer.
- Upload screens to the screenshots section of the Steam Community and tag it with #freerundx, OR post it to your twitter account and include @pixeljamgames and #freerundx in your post as well (if you want your followers to see it as well, don't put @pixeljamgames *right* at the beginning of the tweet).
- Upload videos to Youtube and then link them in the Steam videos section with the tag #freerundx OR post a link to youtube from your twitter account and include #freerundx and @pixeljamgames.

[b]DEADLINE:[/b]
Monday, Feb 8th (end of day)

[b]PRIZES:[/b]
Both videos and screens are their own category, and each has a 1st, 2nd and 3rd place.
1st: Trio of large Dino Run posters mailed to your door & 4 DX Steam Keys to give to friends.
2nd: A single poster mailed to your door and 3 DX Steam Keys
3rd: 2 DX Steam Keys
All places will also get PRESTIGE, which is a special name treatment in multiplayer plus some exclusive hats.

Have fun, and good luck!

notes.title: Help us beta test a major new update.
notes.content:
Hello all,

We've been working on a major new update to the game, and we'd love for everyone to help us test it.  If you are interested, opt-in to the BETA branch. 

Do this by right-clicking on the game name in your steam library, then selecting "properties".  Then choose the menu item "betas", and then from the drop-down menu select the beta called..... "beta" :)   No password is required.

Here is what we added:

- SEED CODES: these determine how a level is constructed, and now you can share them with friends so they can play the exact same level you did.  More info in the OPTIONS section.

- FREE RUN MODE: this is allows you to control the action how you want to... [b]you can even chat with other dinos during multiplayer races![/b].  Full instructions are in the OPTIONS menu as well, towards the bottom of the screen.

Report bugs and give feedback here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/248330/discussions/0/487877107137298276/

Thanks!

notes.title: Halloween Update - Official Launch And 15% Discount Until Nov 2nd
notes.content:
Hello Runners!

Today we officially launched the [b]Halloween update to Dino Run DX[/b]!

- New Challenge Mode [b]HALLOWEEN HELLRUN[/b], with 5 new levels of super bouncy pumpkins, flying witches, gratuitous murder sprees and everything else you expect this time of year.  Also includes brand new music, care of Pixeljam Sound Wizard Mark DeNardo.

- [b]5 New multiplayer zones[/b] as well, and we're now allowing EVERYONE to play all levels.  You must still be a certain level to *create* the race, but anyone can join.

- [b]New hats to unlock[/b], including the coveted black cat for beating Halloween Hellrun on Insane (Only for the HARDCORE).

Also the game is [b]15% off for Steam's Halloween Sale, until Nov 2nd[/b].  Go tell your friends they can save a whole precious dollar, which <old man voice>in our day could buy 3 whole candy bars</voice>.

Enjoy! And take care...

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Schedule of Upcoming Updates and Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello Runners,

Thanks to everyone for a successful launch!  We hope you're enjoying the game and that you've saved a few dinos in the process.

As you may or may not know, DX is a work in progress... we'll be adding content and features over the coming months to make your experience even better.

[b]Here is what's coming up relatively soon:[/b]
- Full Controller Support, so you can navigate every aspect of the game without touching your filthy keyboard.
- Trading Cards
- Squashing a whole bunch of barely perceptible graphics glitches (some are a bit glaring though)
- Optimizing the game to run smoother (a lot of the code was written many years ago and could use a tune up)

[b]Here is what's planned a bit further out:[/b]
- Level Sharing Seed Codes (you get a little code to share with friends so they can play the exact same level as you)
- Free Run Mode for Single and Multiplayer (no doom wall, and you can chat / emote / role-play in the actual race).  This one should be a blast.

All of the things listed above ARE GOING TO HAPPEN, without doubt.   Beyond those we hope to add new hats, colors, levels, terrains, modes of play, etc.  Those things depend on multiple factors, namely Steam sales and crowdfunding outcomes.  More on the crowdfunding here: http://www.pixeljam.com/dinorun

That's all for now.  Thanks for reading, playing and surviving!

-The Pixeljam Team

- Full Controller Support, so you can navigate every aspect of the game without touching your filthy keyboard.
- Trading Cards
- Squashing a whole bunch of barely perceptible graphics glitches (some are a bit glaring though)
- Optimizing the game to run smoother (a lot of the code was written many years ago and could use a tune up)

[b]Here is what's planned a bit further out:[/b]
- Level Sharing Seed Codes (you get a little code to share with friends so they can play the exact same level as you)
- Free Run Mode for Single and Multiplayer (no doom wall, and you can chat / emote / role-play in the actual race).  This one should be a blast.

All of the things listed above ARE GOING TO HAPPEN, without doubt.   Beyond those we hope to add new hats, colors, levels, terrains, modes of play, etc.  Those things depend on multiple factors, namely Steam sales and crowdfunding outcomes.  More on the crowdfunding here: http://www.pixeljam.com/dinorun

That's all for now.  Thanks for reading, playing and surviving!
